Protests at Jantar Mantar Met with Security Measures and Viral Claims

Protests at Jantar Mantar, described as 'Jantar Mantar 2.0' by some outlets, were met with significant security measures across Delhi, including the deployment of spike strips. A video circulated online alleging that Delhi authorities dumped garbage to disrupt the protests, a claim that the Press Information Bureau (PIB) fact-checked and labeled 'fake.' BJP leader Sambit Patra commented on the protests, calling them an 'Anarchists' Flop Show' and stating that 'India is calm and going ahead under good governance,' suggesting the Jantar Mantar events did not represent the broader national narrative.
